title: CLR/90/2014 of Shashi Bhushan Singhal Vs Lalit Mohan Singhal

paras.text:
CLR No. 90 of 2014
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate for the
revisionist.
Mr. J.C. Belwal, Advocate for the respondent.
Modification application no. MCC 627 of 2020
has been filed by the revisionist with the prayer that
in compliance of judgment and order dated
01.09.2020, the revisionist was directed to deposit
the entire decretal amount, adjusting the amount
already paid within two months.
It is contended that due to financial crises, the
revisionist could not pay the same within stipulated
time frame by this Court and prays that further six
months time be granted to the revisionist to deposit
the entire decretal amount, adjusting the amount
already paid.
For the reasons sated, the modification
application is allowed.
Revisionist is directed to pay the 50% of the
entire decretal amount within one month from today
and thereafter remaining amount shall be deposited
thereafter in the next six month.
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.)
mamta 27.11.2020
